search_text: published ZDI-18-131 ZDI-CAN-5087 Novell NetIQ Access Manager OspUIBasicSSODownload Servlet fileInfo1 Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2018-01-19 CVE-2017-14803 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-14803 5.0 ['Novell'] ['NetIQ Access Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Novell NetIQ Access Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the downloadBasicSSOServlet servlet. When parsing the fileInfo1 parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process. Novell has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
